target.value: one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

description.summary: Using words of ancient illusory power, you bestow on all creatures subject to this spell the thought they have heroic powers
description.value: Using words of ancient illusory power, you bestow on all creatures subject to this spell the thought they have heroic powers. They gain a +4 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls, gain 2d8+4 temporary hit points, and become immune to both fear and charm effects for the spell’s duration. At the end of the spell’s duration, the subjects become fatigued.
